display_long_description:
🔨 Become a Carpenter… or Not

Step into a fully interactive VR workshop where every tool feels real and every action matters.

Saw wood, hammer nails, and assemble pieces with true-to-life physics.
Every movement is in your hands.

🪵 Satisfying Crafting Mechanics

Feel the difference:

Pull the saw back and forth
Hit nails with precision
Snap pieces perfectly into place

Built for maximum immersion and satisfying gameplay.

😂 Or Just Break Everything

Not in the mood to build?

Go wild:

Throw objects
Smash furniture
Create chaos

This is not just a simulator… it’s a sandbox.

🧩 Challenge Yourself
Multiple levels with increasing difficulty
From simple tasks to complex builds
Test your precision and creativity

Can you master every project?

🎮 Designed for VR
Realistic hand interaction
Physics-driven gameplay
Smooth and responsive controls

Made for Meta Quest players who love immersive experiences

🔥 Why You’ll Love It
Satisfying gameplay loop
Easy to start, hard to master
Perfect mix of simulation + fun + chaos
🎯 Final CTA

Step into the workshop.
